review:
Fortuna Trueways is set on Mount Olympus, where the goddess Fortuna spins her wheel. When she appears on reels 3 and 4 she becomes an expanded wild, and a Mystery symbol transforms into a random character before paying.

The Wheel of Fortune can split a cell into smaller ones, adding ways. The Hold and Win bonus awards a Dynamic Prize for holding between 12 and 48 coins, so the size of the coin grid matters. BGaming rates the game very high volatility with a 10,000x maximum and a 97.07% RTP. It has more mechanics than most Trueways games, so the demo is a good place to learn how they interact.
pros: Excellent 97.07% RTP – among the highest published
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
